draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 209th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 18th of 19 at RB. He went 172nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (209th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Dexter McCluster. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,090 rushing yards in 2019, 11th of 19 RBs in his class with stats.
